description: This file defines the NamedExampleStorageFactory class, which implements the INamedExampleStorageFactory interface. It provides a method to create storage instances based on a name and configuration, utilizing dependency injection to retrieve the appropriate storage factory.

classes.name: NamedExampleStorageFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates named storage instances using dependency injection.
